Name: Cotton Candy Chicken
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🍬 [b]Cotton Candy Chicken[/b]
This mod adds a cute cotton candy themed chicken to Stardew Valley.
You can buy [b]Cotton Candy Chickens as chicks from Marnie[/b] just like normal chickens. Once they grow up, they will start producing [b]Cotton Candy Eggs[/b]. These eggs can be placed into the [b]Mayonnaise Machine[/b] to create [b]Cotton Candy Mayo[/b].

[b]Prices and stats:
[/b]Cotton Candy Chicken purchase price: [b]750g[/b]
Cotton Candy Egg sell price: [b]150g[/b]
Cotton Candy Egg energy: [b]40[/b]
Cotton Candy Egg health: [b]18[/b]
Cotton Candy Mayo sell price: [b]600g[/b]
Cotton Candy Mayo energy: [b]60[/b]
Cotton Candy Mayo health: [b]27[/b]
The items behave just like regular eggs and mayonnaise, but with a fun cotton candy theme.

[b]Requirements
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]
[b]Installation[/b]
Download the mod and extract it into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.
Example mod path:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/AbrahCottonCandyChicken[/code]Make sure [b]each mod stays inside its own folder[/b] and do not mix files from different mods together, otherwise SMAPI will not load them correctly.
Start the game through SMAPI and the Cotton Candy Chicken will appear at [b]Marnie’s shop[/b].
Enjoy your sweet pastel chickens 🍬🐔
